summary_1line: Vasishtha persuades King Dasaratha to keep his promise and allow Rama to accompany Vishwamitra, affirming duty, honor, and the sage’s unmatched power.

image_candidates.scene_text: The enraged sage’s words cause the earth to tremble while frightened gods look on as King Dasaratha sits shaken in his court.
Sage Vasishtha calmly raises his hand in the royal court, urging King Dasaratha to honor his promise and send Rama with Vishwamitra.
